site.content:
# Larderello (Italy)
# Generated by tools/build_site_files.py from borethm.comparative_sites.LARDERELLO.
# Snapshot of the built-in inputs in the generation environment.
# Recomputed numerical fits can differ in their last digits across platforms.
# Edit a copy for your site; regenerate this file from the Python definition.
# Units: depths m; temperatures C; gradients Pa/m or C/m as named;
# stresses and strengths Pa; conductivity W/(m K); ratios dimensionless.
# Stress and pore pressure use gauge values relative to 0.1 MPa absolute.
# Geotherm tables: borethm.comparative_sites.make_geotherm.
# Stress cases: borethm.site_evaluation.transitional_bounds.

name = "Larderello (Italy)"
target_depth = 2850.0
target_T = 400.0
Sv_grad = 25506.0
K0_min = 0.55
SHmax_over_Sv = 0.75
rho_fluid_grad = 10000.0
k_rock = 2.6
E_rock = 45000000000.0
UCS = 140000000.0
T_inj = 40.0
stress_basis = "regime bounds"
strength_cases = [["site UCS", 140000000.0]]
target_depth_v11 = 2400.0
temperature_data_to = 2900.0
mu = 0.8
coupled = false

[geotherm]
form = "segments"
boundary = "below"
segments = [
    [0, 15, 0.152],
    [2200, 350, 0.077],
]

[geotherm_v11]
form = "segments"
boundary = "below"
segments = [
    [0, 15, 0.152],
    [2200, 350, 0.2504],
    [2815, 504, 0.1],
]

[stress_rule]
form = "transitional"
Sv_grad = 25506.0
source = "regime: normal/strike-slip transition (Liotta & Brogi)"

[data_basis]
"stress" = ["regime bounds", "Liotta & Brogi (manuscript, Geothermics); no magnitudes published"]
"strength" = ["unsourced", "v1.0 140 MPa; only an Elba micaschist analogue found"]
"pore pressure" = ["assumed", "hydrostatic; vapour-dominated field, with over-pressured fluids reported along active faults"]
"temperature" = ["measured", "Venelle-2 to 2.9 km (Bertani et al. 2018)"]
"well check" = ["none", "Venelle-2 drilled to 2.9 km (losses, stuck pipe), but no breakout data published"]
